### Summary of Work Done

- **Updated `slugify` implementation**: In [`slug/__init__.py`](file:///tmp/agy-real-smoke-state-3yxa_r_u/jobs/8f3c843a-7c71-484c-acba-ddd535755749/work/slug/__init__.py), updated [`slugify`](file:///tmp/agy-real-smoke-state-3yxa_r_u/jobs/8f3c843a-7c71-484c-acba-ddd535755749/work/slug/__init__.py#L8-L19) to:

  - Repeated spaces and hyphens collapsing ([`test_slugify_repeated_spaces`](file:///tmp/agy-real-smoke-state-3yxa_r_u/jobs/8f3c843a-7c71-484c-acba-ddd535755749/work/tests/test_slug.py#L15-L19))

  - Preserved the existing [`test_slugify_basic`](file:///tmp/agy-real-smoke-state-3yxa_r_u/jobs/8f3c843a-7c71-484c-acba-ddd535755749/work/tests/test_slug.py#L4-L5) test.
- **Maintained job artifacts**: Updated [`.agy/PLAN.md`](file:///tmp/agy-real-smoke-state-3yxa_r_u/jobs/8f3c843a-7c71-484c-acba-ddd535755749/work/.agy/PLAN.md), [`.agy/NOTES.md`](file:///tmp/agy-real-smoke-state-3yxa_r_u/jobs/8f3c843a-7c71-484c-acba-ddd535755749/work/.agy/NOTES.md), [`.agy/REPORT.md`](file:///tmp/agy-real-smoke-state-3yxa_r_u/jobs/8f3c843a-7c71-484c-acba-ddd535755749/work/.agy/REPORT.md), and [`.agy/COMMIT_MSG`](file:///tmp/agy-real-smoke-state-3yxa_r_u/jobs/8f3c843a-7c71-484c-acba-ddd535755749/work/.agy/COMMIT_MSG).

### Assumptions Made

1. **Separators**: Whitespace and hyphens are treated as separators and collapsed into a single hyphen `'-'`.
2. **Punctuation Characters**: All standard ASCII punctuation (`string.punctuation`) and unicode punctuation categories are stripped, excluding `'-'` which serves as a separator.
3. **Empty Input**: Inputs that are empty or consist entirely of whitespace, punctuation, or hyphens result in an empty string (`""`).
4. **Verification**: Per instructions, verification tests are executed by the wrapper rather than agy directly.
